culprit_citations.quoted_text: Ratio of net investment income to average net assets | 9.41 | %

rationale: Raw source shows 2025 distributions of about 1.03 per share/1.029 total declared per share and a 2025 ratio of net investment income to average net assets of 9.41%. The F16 threshold from the source income-yield anchor is 9.41 * 1.5 = 14.115%, which is above the flagged observed distribution rate of 10.28144376899696%, so the fail is caused by the validation anchor/input rather than a reported fund-financial data error.
